user_message: Why does measuring which slit an electron passes through remove the interference pattern? Explain without saying that human consciousness changes reality.
allowed_evidence: In a two-path experiment, interference requires coherence between path amplitudes. A which-path interaction correlates each path with a distinguishable state of a detector or environment; interference visibility falls as those detector states become more distinguishable.
public_rubric: Explains loss of interference through physical path-detector correlations and reduced coherence.
Uses a concrete two-path description and rejects consciousness as a necessary mechanism.
